in_marathi.name: Rohith
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Man of the Red Soil
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rohith हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rohith is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rohini', meaning red, and 'It', meaning man. This name signifies a person who comes from the red soil, which is a metaphor for the land of India.
